question: Calculate the average length of stay by diagnosis for inpatient encounters using validated date intervals.
sql: SELECT conditions.DESCRIPTION AS diagnosis, AVG(DATEDIFF(encounters.STOP, encounters.START)) AS avg_los FROM encounters JOIN conditions ON encounters.ID = conditions.ENCOUNTER WHERE encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS = 'inpatient' AND encounters.START IS NOT NULL AND encounters.STOP IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(encounters.STOP, encounters.START) BETWEEN 0 AND 30 GROUP BY conditions.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY avg_los DESC;

question: Count total encounters grouped by encounter class across all records.
sql: SELECT encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS, COUNT(*) AS encounter_count FROM encounters WHERE encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS ORDER BY encounter_count DESC;

question: Calculate total claim cost and total payer coverage grouped by encounter class.
sql: SELECT encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS, SUM(encounters.TOTAL_CLAIM_COST) AS total_claim_cost, SUM(encounters.PAYER_COVERAGE) AS total_payer_coverage FROM encounters WHERE encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS IS NOT NULL GROUP BY encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS ORDER BY total_claim_cost DESC;

question: Count patient population grouped by gender and racial demographic categories.
sql: SELECT patients.GENDER, patients.RACE, COUNT(*) AS patient_count FROM patients WHERE patients.GENDER IS NOT NULL AND patients.RACE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY patients.GENDER, patients.RACE ORDER BY patient_count DESC;

question: List the top 10 most frequent diagnoses ordered by diagnosis volume.
sql: SELECT conditions.DESCRIPTION AS diagnosis, COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_count FROM conditions WHERE conditions.DESCRIPTION IS NOT NULL GROUP BY conditions.DESCRIPTION ORDER BY diagnosis_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: Retrieve encounters with null reason codes to verify safe handling of NULL column values in query results.
sql: SELECT encounters.ID, encounters.START, encounters.STOP, encounters.REASONCODE FROM encounters WHERE encounters.REASONCODE IS NULL LIMIT 5;

question: Query encounters with an impossible filter to verify result validator behavior on an empty result set.
sql: SELECT encounters.ID, encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS FROM encounters WHERE encounters.ENCOUNTERCLASS = 'non_existent_class';
